cycle_events.scope: Explicit reset-release pulse or sampled-transition output; public edge obligations only
repair_invariants: Bind the triggering event, sampled inputs, observation edge and pulse duration before choosing state/output registers
Every nonblocking assignment reads pre-edge values; compute the required post-edge output without accidental extra latency
A sampled transition pulse persists between active edges; live input changes must not erase it
Repair state, next-state, data publication and reset consistently; retain correct encodings and unrelated behavior

serial.scope: Explicit start/data/stop receiver; optional payload output; no inferred oversampling, parity or baud timing
repair_invariants: Separate frame position from output projection: a completion-only receiver still consumes every public data bit
Start consumes one edge; N following edges consume N data bits; the next edge checks stop
A valid stop completes exactly once; missing stop enters recovery, and recovery delimiter must not complete the invalid frame
Reset discards partial reception; pulse and state reset together; only compare payload when it is publicly valid
checks: missing stop then delimiter and a fresh frame

bcd.scope: Explicit synchronous packed decimal up-counter; not arbitrary enable mappings
repair_invariants: All digits including the highest wrap 9 to 0
Carry into digit k depends on every lower digit being 9 before the edge
Compute all digit updates from the same old state; reset and output enable conventions follow the public specification

fsm.scope: Knowledge card only; no generic executable oracle implemented
repair_invariants: Write transition conditions for every state and legal input before encoding states
Distinguish Moore outputs from Mealy outputs and the edge when each becomes visible
State, counter, storage and reset must describe the same cycle; specify terminal and recovery transitions
unsupported: diagram not represented in public text
